name: Manifest Greed
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level arcanist 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, cleric/oracle/warpriest 6, summoner 4, unchained summoner 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a gold coin)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 1 dragon
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Note: This spell was designed to be used by dragons, thus it may alter or replace core dragon abilities (like frightful presence etc.)

A purple arc lashes out from your hand toward the targeted dragon, unleashing its innate greed. Upon a failed Will save, the target becomes sickened as its greed manifests. This manifestation takes the form of an ectoplasmic creature which is one size category larger than the target creature. The manifestation has half the hit points of the target and all of its natural attacks and armor class. The manifestation has none of the target’s special qualities or abilities (Sp, Su, or Ex) but does gain DR 10/ . The manifested greed has no feats or skills. It does not have an Int score, and its Wis and Cha become 10. The manifested greed can be commanded, as a free action, by the caster that created it.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
